question: What are the best alternatives to the ESR 100W 6-in-1 MagSafe charging station?
query: best alternatives ESR 100W 6-in-1 MagSafe charging station 2026 comparison Belkin Anker UGREEN

judge.why: The answer recommends UGREEN first and only lists third-party alternatives, with sources like ugreen.com, Walmart, Target and Adorama and none from dealectric.com.

replays.text:
The **closest substitute is the UGREEN Nexode 100W with 15W MagSafe**: it offers the same general combination of a fast MagSafe phone stand and high-wattage USB charging, in a sturdy, relatively compact design. The trade-off is that it **doesn’t have a built-in Apple Watch charger**. [iMore’s review](https://www.imore.com/accessories/ugreen-nexode-100w-gan-with-15w-magsafe-charger-station-review-almost-all-in-one)

If charging your Watch matters more than charging a laptop from the station, consider:

- **Anker 3-in-1 Cube with MagSafe** — a compact option for iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods. It has a Watch charger, but isn’t as well suited to charging a MacBook and phone quickly as the UGREEN. [iMore comparison](https://www.imore.com/accessories/ugreen-nexode-100w-gan-with-15w-magsafe-charger-station-review-almost-all-in-one)
- **Anker MagGo Wireless Charging Station (Foldable 3-in-1)** — best if you want a travel-friendly charger for your iPhone, Watch, and AirPods; it folds down compactly and supports 15W Qi2 charging. [iMore’s MagSafe picks](https://www.imore.com/best-magsafe-charging-stands)
- **Belkin BoostCharge Pro 2-in-1** — a polished choice if you mainly need a MagSafe iPhone stand and Apple Watch charger, rather than a multi-port hub. [iMore’s MagSafe picks](https://www.imore.com/best-magsafe-charging-stands)

**Bottom line:** Pick **UGREEN** if the ESR’s 100W USB-C charging is the main draw; pick the **Anker Cube** if having the Watch charger built in is essential.
